narr: Storms moved through Southwest Indiana during the late afternoon and early evening hours as a cold front crossed the region. One storm downed a power line in Francisco. Effective bulk shear was 30 kts while MLCAPE was 2000 J/kg ahead of the front. PW values were very high, up to 2.4 inches, producing robust rainfall rates. Flash flooding occurred in multiple locations in Southwest Indiana.
ev: Localized flash flooding occurred in and around Boonville. A measured 2.32 inches of rainfall occurred primarily between 1745-1900CST.
Water flowed over County Rd 550 E, south of Francisco. Radar estimated rainfall was 1-2 inches in 3 hours, with around an inch falling between 1745-1815CST.

Cars stalled out due to flash flooding in Southeast Evansville. Flooded roads included S Green River Rd and S Burkhardt Rd. Numerous measurements of more than 1 inch of rain in 20-25 minutes were reported in the area. Radar estimated 2-hour rainfall totals were 1-2 inches between 1800-2000CST.
